properties.title: Section L Hatchobori
properties.description: A quiet residential base near Ginza and Tokyo Station.

properties.title: Section L Ginza East
properties.description: A neighbourhood stay between Ginza’s shops and Tsukiji’s food scene.

properties.title: Section L Residence Ginza
properties.description: A base for galleries, luxury boutiques and fine dining.

neighbourhoods.title: Hatchobori
neighbourhoods.description: A residential pocket with parks, local restaurants and easy access to Disneyland.

hashtag.title: Local Life
hashtag.description: Quiet parks, local dining and a distinctive library.

neighbourhoods.title: Tsukiji
neighbourhoods.description: A seafood district with fresh fish and specialist kitchenware.

hashtag.title: Sushi Town
hashtag.description: Watch seafood preparation and browse handcrafted culinary tools.

neighbourhoods.title: Ginza
neighbourhoods.description: An entertainment district with luxury shops, galleries and gourmet dining.

hashtag.title: Endless Luxury
hashtag.description: Browse small galleries between shopping and fine dining.

city_gems.title: Turret Coffee
city_gems.short_description: Matcha and seasonal lattes at a small independent café.
city_gems.long_description: Look for the red bench. The menu also features seasonal drinks and hot spiced cider.

city_gems.title: Maru
city_gems.short_description: Wine and small plates in a tucked-away spot.
city_gems.long_description: Browse the wine shelves and try tapas such as asparagus gratin or anchovy butter fries.

city_gems.title: Nihombashi Sando
city_gems.short_description: A modern izakaya serving Japanese classics.
city_gems.long_description: Try sashimi, cream croquettes and sake from Nagano.

city_gems.title: Postalco
city_gems.short_description: A Tokyo design studio and shop with roots in New York.
city_gems.long_description: The collection brings everyday design to stationery, bags and clothing.

city_gems.title: FEELSEEN
city_gems.short_description: A shop with carefully selected artisan goods.
city_gems.long_description: A couple curates the collection in a building once used as quarters for kabuki performers.

city_gems.title: Ginza Six Rooftop
city_gems.short_description: A rooftop retreat with views of Ginza.
city_gems.long_description: Look for the small shrine and take in the street views from above.

city_gems.title: Cafe Ajito .N
city_gems.short_description: A café with a sheep figure at the entrance.
city_gems.long_description: The menu pairs lamb taco rice with drinks such as a date-and-almond latte.

city_gems.title: Teppozu Inari Shrine
city_gems.short_description: A quiet shrine tucked into a residential area.
city_gems.long_description: Behind the shrine is a small Mount Fuji replica made with volcanic rock.

city_gems.title: Senmaiya
city_gems.short_description: A small shop with a wide selection of rice balls.
city_gems.long_description: Choose from classic onigiri fillings and look for the brown-rice option.

city_gems.title: Shutoku Ganso
city_gems.short_description: An intimate omakase sushi counter in an alley.
city_gems.long_description: Choose from three courses at the eight-seat counter.

city_gems.title: Ichifuji
city_gems.short_description: A kitchenware shop for useful gifts and souvenirs.
city_gems.long_description: Browse cooking tools and tableware for something to take home.

city_gems.title: Kunisuke Coffee
city_gems.short_description: A plant-covered coffee shop with a cosy interior.
city_gems.long_description: The café serves coffee and changing pastries, with Japanese-language puzzle games upstairs.
